description: Exports a wallet's tokenized-stock and yield-token trade history as a record (for example for an accountant; not tax advice and not a tax calculation). Reconstructs USDC to xStock and USDC to yield-token swaps from on-chain history, deriving each execution price from the transaction's own balance changes. Returns structured trades (date, buy/sell, asset, amount, USDC, price, Solscan link) and a CSV string for the last N signatures (default 100). Read-only.

limit.description: How many recent signatures to scan (default 100, max 200)

name: export_history
